name: AMR Systems
comments: Core scalable product. Automated material routing for corrugated end-of-line. Target: 4–6 units/year = ~€1.0M annual revenue. OEE improvement focus. Medium sales cycle (3–5 months).

name: Easy Pack
comments: Volume driver product. Automated packing systems for corrugated converting. Target: 5–7 units/year = ~€0.9M annual revenue. High SKU variability compatibility. Fast ROI.

name: Palletizer
comments: High-value robotic palletizing system. Target: 1–2 units/year = ~€0.6M annual revenue. Strategic upside. Longer sales cycle (6–9 months). High margin potential.

name: Ingetrans
comments: Strategic flagship — heavy corrugated board transport systems. ~0.6 units/year = ~€0.7M revenue. Highest single-deal risk and reward. USA market priority. Requires C-level relationship.

name: Retal
comments: Scrap/trim management system. High frequency, low price = volume. Target: 6–10 units/year = ~€0.7M annual revenue. Fastest ROI product (<12 months). Strong recurring installed base.

name: Service & Maintenance
comments: Annual maintenance contracts + T&M interventions. €45/h rate, €30/h cost, €15/h margin. Current capacity: ~2,000 h/year in Catalunya. Scale target: 14 technicians = 24,500 h = €1.1M revenue potential.

name: Custom Engineering Projects
comments: Bespoke industrial automation. Strategic role only. Target: €0.5M/year. Selected for innovation, strategic accounts, or complex solutions. Not required for survival — chosen, not needed.

name: Quick Throughput Pack
comments: 4–8 week deployment. Focus: logistics optimization, scrap reduction, safety improvements. ROI < 12–15 months. Entry offer for new account activation.

name: Smart Changeover Cell
comments: 8–12 week deployment. Focus: robotics + OEE improvement for high-variability SKU plants. ROI < 12–18 months. Targets converting plants with frequent changeovers.

name: Greenfield Assist
comments: 12–24 weeks. Full end-of-line project integration for new or converted plants. Strategic accounts only. Highest relationship and complexity requirement.
